_about: People: NPC traits, goals with steps (a goal that reaches its last step becomes a storyteller pitch), the ties between people, the memories that move an NPC's opinion of the party, and how often the people near the party act when time advances. grudges: what someone who thinks badly enough of the party (opinion at or below threshold) does about it, at most once per cooldownDays; an act needs their opinion at or below its min. standing moves the party's standing where they live; friends moves the opinion of their friends and family; threat marks a danger the DM should plan for.

traits.name: Ambitious
traits.text: Wants more than they have, and works for it.

traits.name: Content
traits.text: Happy with their lot; hard to tempt.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.text: Counts everything in spirit coins.

traits.name: Generous
traits.text: Gives freely, sometimes too freely.

traits.name: Kind
traits.text: Helps strangers without being asked.

traits.name: Cruel
traits.text: Enjoys other people's pain a little too much.

traits.name: Honest
traits.text: Says what they mean, even when it costs them.

traits.name: Sly
traits.text: Never quite says what they mean.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Walks toward danger.

traits.name: Cautious
traits.text: Checks twice, then checks again.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.text: Acts first; regrets later, sometimes.

traits.name: Pious
traits.text: Keeps the rites of their church and expects others to.

traits.name: Sceptic
traits.text: Trusts no church, no god and few people.

traits.name: Proud
traits.text: Will not be seen to lose.

traits.name: Humble
traits.text: Shrugs off praise and gives the credit away.

traits.name: Jealous
traits.text: Keeps a careful tally of what others have.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.text: Stands by friends long after it stops being wise.

traits.name: Fickle
traits.text: Their loyalties last about a season.

traits.name: Vengeful
traits.text: Never forgets a slight and always repays it.

traits.name: Forgiving
traits.text: Lets old wrongs go.

traits.name: Curious
traits.text: Has to know how things work, and what is behind the door.

traits.name: Studious
traits.text: Lives among books, notes and essence theory.

traits.name: Lazy
traits.text: Does the least that will do.

traits.name: Driven
traits.text: Works through the night and expects others to.

traits.name: Charming
traits.text: Gets their way with a smile.

traits.name: Gruff
traits.text: Short words, shorter temper, good heart (maybe).

traits.name: Shy
traits.text: Avoids crowds and attention.

traits.name: Gregarious
traits.text: Knows everyone in town and their business.

traits.name: Romantic
traits.text: Falls in love easily and loudly.

traits.name: Cold
traits.text: Keeps everyone at arm's length.

traits.name: Protective
traits.text: Would burn the world down for their family.

traits.name: Family first
traits.text: Everything they do is for their kin.

traits.name: Rebellious
traits.text: Pushes against every rule and ruler.

traits.name: Dutiful
traits.text: Follows the rules, the chain of command and the contract.

traits.name: Scheming
traits.text: Always has a plan, and a plan behind it.

traits.name: Gossip
traits.text: Cannot keep a secret to save their life.

traits.name: Ruthless
traits.text: Does what it takes.

traits.name: Idealist
traits.text: Believes the world can be better, and acts like it.

traits.name: Bitter
traits.text: Remembers what life took from them.

traits.name: Thrill-seeker
traits.text: Bored unless something is trying to kill them.

goals.name: Get rich
steps: {person} is borrowing to buy into a {goods} venture in {place}.
{person}'s {goods} venture is paying, and they are buying out partners.
{person} is close to owning most of the {goods} trade in {place}.

climax.title: {person} corners the {goods}
climax.text: {person} now controls most of the {goods} in {place}, and prices are climbing.
climax.dm: {person} has bought, bullied and bribed their way here. Some partners did not sell willingly.
climax.goal: Find out how {person} did it, and decide whether {place} needs saving from them.

goals.name: Reach the next rank
steps: {person} has started taking harder contracts from the Adventure Society.
{person} is buying monster cores and pushing their essences hard.
{person} is ready to face the assessment for the next rank.

climax.title: {person}'s assessment
climax.text: {person} faces their rank assessment at the Adventure Society and wants a team at their back for the field test.
climax.dm: {person} has been using too many cores; the residue could make them fail at the worst moment.
climax.goal: Help {person} through the field test, or watch them fail it.

goals.name: Avenge a wrong
goals.wants: avenge a wrong done to their family
steps: {person} has learned the name of whoever wronged their family.
{person} is watching {rival}, learning their habits.
{person} has the means and the moment to strike at {rival}.

climax.title: {person} takes revenge
climax.text: {person} means to settle an old score with {rival} in {place}, tonight.
climax.dm: {rival} is guilty, but not of everything {person} believes. Someone else set them against each other.
climax.goal: Stop it, help it, or find the truth first.

goals.name: Win someone's heart
steps: {person} has fallen for {rival} and cannot stop talking about it.
{person} is courting {rival} with gifts and bad poetry.
{person} has planned a grand gesture to win {rival}.

climax.title: {person}'s grand gesture
climax.text: {person} wants help with a grand gesture to win {rival}: a rare flower from a dangerous place, a song, a duel, something.
climax.dm: {rival} already loves someone else and has been too kind to say so.
climax.goal: Help with the gesture, or with the heartbreak.

goals.name: Found a shrine
goals.wants: found a shrine of the {church} in {place}
steps: {person} is collecting donations for a shrine of the {church} in {place}.
{person} has bought a plot and builders are at work.
The shrine is almost finished, and {person} needs a relic to bless it.

climax.title: A relic for the shrine
climax.text: {person}'s shrine in {place} needs a relic before it can be blessed, and the one they want lies in a monster-haunted ruin.
climax.dm: A rival church wants the shrine to fail and has paid someone to make sure the relic never arrives.
climax.goal: Fetch the relic and see the shrine blessed.

goals.name: Ruin a rival house
steps: {person} is collecting secrets about {faction}.
{person} is quietly turning {faction}'s allies against it.
{person} has enough to ruin {faction}, and means to use it.

climax.title: {person} moves against {faction}
climax.text: {person} is about to make public what they know about {faction}, and the city will take sides.
climax.dm: Half of what {person} has is forged. The other half is worse than anyone suspects.
climax.goal: Decide what happens to the secret before it breaks.

goals.name: Leave it all behind
steps: {person} has been selling their things quietly.
{person} has bought passage through the teleportation circle under another name.
{person} is ready to vanish from {place}.

climax.title: {person} vanishes
climax.text: {person} has gone, and someone in {place} is paying well to have them found.
climax.dm: {person} fled a debt to a dangerous house. Finding them could get them killed.
climax.goal: Find {person}, or help them stay lost.

goals.name: Master a craft
steps: {person} has taken on an old master in {place} as a teacher.
{person}'s work is starting to sell for real money.
{person} is entering a contest that will decide who is the best {craft} in {place}.

climax.title: The contest in {place}
climax.text: The {craft}s of {place} hold a contest, and {person} needs a rare material to win it.
climax.dm: Their rival is cheating, with help from a merchant who wants {person} to lose.
climax.goal: Find the material, and maybe the cheat.

goals.name: Keep their family safe
steps: {person} has heard threats against their family.
{person} is hiring guards they cannot afford.
{person} has found who is behind the threats.

climax.title: {person}'s family is threatened
climax.text: Someone has been threatening {person}'s family in {place}, and the guards {person} hired have run off.
climax.dm: The threats come from {rival}, over a debt {person} never told their family about.
climax.goal: Protect the family and settle what is owed.

goals.name: Take a seat of power
goals.wants: take a seat on the council of {place}
steps: {person} is making friends in the right houses in {place}.
{person} is spending heavily on gifts and favours.
{person} needs one more vote to take a council seat.

climax.title: {person} wants the last vote
climax.text: {person} is one vote short of a seat on the council of {place}, and the last voter wants a favour done.
climax.dm: The favour is ugly: proof against a rival, real or not.
climax.goal: Win the vote for {person}, or make sure they lose it.

goals.name: Find a cure
goals.wants: find a cure for a sick relative
steps: {person}'s relative is ill with a sickness the healers cannot name.
{person} has heard of a cure, far off and costly.
{person} has the coin for the cure but no one to fetch it.

climax.title: A cure for {person}'s kin
climax.text: {person} has found a cure for their sick relative, but it grows in a dangerous place.
climax.dm: The sickness is not natural. Someone close to the family is behind it.
climax.goal: Bring the cure back, and maybe find who made them ill.

goals.name: Pay off a debt
steps: {person} owes more than they can earn to {rival}.
{person} is taking risky work to pay {rival} back.
{rival} has called in the debt, all of it, now.

climax.title: {rival} calls in the debt
climax.text: {rival} has called in {person}'s whole debt, and {person} cannot pay.
climax.dm: {rival} wants {person}'s property, not the coins, and forged part of the debt.
climax.goal: Find the money, the forgery, or another way out.

goals.name: Expose a cult
steps: {person} has noticed people in {place} going missing at the new moon.
{person} has followed a cultist to a meeting place.
{person} knows the cult's next gathering and needs help to break it up.

climax.title: The cult in {place}
climax.text: {person} knows where a hidden cult gathers in {place}, and the next gathering is soon.
climax.dm: The cult has a member on the town watch. {person} is already being followed.
climax.goal: Break up the gathering and save who they mean to sacrifice.

goals.name: Find a lost place
goals.wants: find a lost ruin spoken of in old books
steps: {person} has found an old map in a library in {place}.
{person} has narrowed the ruin down to a valley in the wilds.
{person} has found the entrance but cannot go in alone.

climax.title: {person}'s lost ruin
climax.text: {person} has found the entrance to a lost ruin and wants a team to go inside.
climax.dm: The ruin is an old astral space, and it is waking up.
climax.goal: Explore the ruin with {person}.

goals.name: Beat a rival
steps: {person} has lost to {rival} again and swears it was the last time.
{person} is training and buying better gear.
{person} has challenged {rival} to a public duel.

climax.title: The duel in {place}
climax.text: {person} has challenged {rival} to a duel in {place}, and half the town is coming to watch.
climax.dm: {person} has bought a cursed weapon to make sure of it.
climax.goal: Watch, bet, stop it, or find the cursed weapon.

goals.name: Free someone
steps: {person}'s friend has been jailed in {place} on a charge {person} swears is false.
{person} is gathering proof and allies.
{person} plans to break their friend out.

climax.title: {person}'s jailbreak
climax.text: {person} plans to break a friend out of jail in {place}, with or without help.
climax.dm: The friend is guilty, but the real crime was ordered by someone powerful.
climax.goal: Find the truth, or help with the jailbreak.

goals.name: Win an inheritance
goals.wants: claim an inheritance from a dead relative
steps: A relative of {person} has died and left a fortune with no clear heir.
{person} is fighting {rival} over the will.
The will is to be read, and {person} expects to lose.

climax.title: The will
climax.text: The will of a rich relative of {person} is read in {place}, and {rival} has brought armed friends.
climax.dm: There is a second will, hidden somewhere in the dead man's house.
climax.goal: Find the second will or keep the peace at the reading.

goals.name: Gain a rare essence
steps: {person} has set their heart on a rare essence.
{person} has saved enough spirit coins for half of it.
{person} has found someone selling the essence, below its price.

climax.title: The cheap essence
climax.text: {person} has found the rare essence they want, for sale below its price, and wants someone to come along to buy it.
climax.dm: It's stolen. The owner wants it back and is not forgiving.
climax.goal: Help {person} buy it, or find out where it came from.

goals.name: Make amends
goals.wants: make amends for an old wrong
steps: {person} has confessed an old wrong to a priest of the {church}.
{person} is looking for the family they wronged.
{person} has found them, and they want more than an apology.

climax.title: {person}'s amends
climax.text: {person} has found the family they wronged long ago and needs help to make it right.
climax.dm: The family wants {person} to give up their rank badge, or their home.
climax.goal: Help {person} make amends, or bargain for them.

goals.name: Build a team
steps: {person} is recruiting for a new team at the Adventure Society.
{person} has two members, and they don't get along.
{person}'s team is about to take its first real contract.

climax.title: {person}'s first contract
climax.text: {person}'s new team takes its first contract and is out of its depth.
climax.dm: One of the team is working for a rival team that wants them to fail.
climax.goal: Rescue the team, or teach them how it's done.

goals.name: Run a smuggling ring
steps: {person} has started moving untaxed {goods} through {place}.
{person}'s ring is growing, and the watch has noticed.
{person} has one big shipment that will make them, or break them.

climax.title: The big shipment
climax.text: {person}'s biggest smuggling run comes through {place} this week.
climax.dm: The shipment is not {goods}. It's something {person} would never have agreed to carry.
climax.goal: Stop the shipment, take a cut, or find what's really in it.

goals.name: Mend a family feud
steps: {person} has written to {rival} after years of silence.
{person} and {rival} have met, and it went badly.
{person} has arranged a family dinner to settle it.

climax.title: The family dinner
climax.text: {person} has invited {rival} and the whole family to dinner in {place} to end the feud.
climax.dm: Someone at the table wants the feud to go on, and has poisoned the wine.
climax.goal: Keep the peace, and the guests alive.

goals.name: Make a discovery
steps: {person} has a theory about essences no one believes.
{person}'s experiments have started to work, and to go wrong.
{person} is ready for the test that will prove them right.

climax.title: {person}'s experiment
climax.text: {person}'s big experiment in {place} is set for tonight, and the Magic Society wants it stopped.
climax.dm: The experiment will work, and draw something from beyond.
climax.goal: Help, stop it, or stand ready for what comes through.

goals.name: Be accepted
goals.wants: be accepted by the people of {place}
steps: {person} is new in {place} and the locals don't trust them.
{person} is working hard to win people over.
{person} has a chance to prove themselves at the next festival.

climax.title: {person} at the festival
climax.text: {person} wants to win the people of {place} over at the coming festival, and has a plan that could go badly wrong.
climax.dm: Someone in town wants {person} gone and will sabotage it.
climax.goal: Help {person} win them over.

goals.name: Hunt a monster
goals.wants: hunt the monster that scarred them
steps: {person} has heard the monster that scarred them was seen near {place}.
{person} is tracking it.
{person} has found its lair.

climax.title: {person}'s hunt
climax.text: {person} has found the lair of the monster that scarred them years ago and is going in, alone if need be.
climax.dm: It's bigger than it was. It has been eating cores.
climax.goal: Help {person} kill it.

goals.name: Sell a secret
goals.wants: sell a secret to the highest bidder
steps: {person} has learned something {faction} would pay to keep quiet.
{person} has been sounding out buyers.
{person} has set up an auction of the secret, tonight.

climax.title: A secret for sale
climax.text: {person} is selling a secret about {faction} to the highest bidder in {place}.
climax.dm: {faction} knows, and has sent someone to make sure there is no sale.
climax.goal: Buy the secret, protect {person}, or let it play out.

goals.name: Make a pilgrimage
steps: {person} has vowed to make a pilgrimage for the {church}.
{person} is saving for the journey and the circle fee.
{person} sets out, and asks for an escort.

climax.title: {person}'s pilgrimage
climax.text: {person} sets out on a pilgrimage and wants an escort for the dangerous first stretch.
climax.dm: The road is watched by bandits who know pilgrims carry offerings.
climax.goal: Escort {person}.

goals.name: Marry well
steps: {person} has their eye on an heir of a rich family in {place}.
{person} is courting the heir, and the heir's family is not pleased.
The wedding is set, if the family doesn't stop it.

climax.title: The wedding
climax.text: {person}'s wedding into a rich family in {place} is this week, and the family wants it stopped.
climax.dm: {person} loves the heir. The heir is the one marrying for money.
climax.goal: Keep the wedding on, or stop it.

goals.name: Clear their name
goals.wants: clear their name of a crime
steps: {person} is accused of a crime in {place} they did not commit.
{person} has found a witness who saw the real culprit.
The witness has gone missing.

climax.title: The missing witness
climax.text: {person}'s witness has vanished, and with them {person}'s best chance of clearing their name.
climax.dm: The witness was paid to vanish by the real culprit, who is close to {person}.
climax.goal: Find the witness.

goals.name: Pass on what they know
steps: {person} is looking for a student to pass their knowledge on to.
{person} has found a promising student, from a poor family.
The student's family wants them home, and {person} needs help to change their mind.

climax.title: {person}'s student
climax.text: {person}'s new student is being pulled home by family debts, and {person} wants help to keep them.
climax.dm: The family owes money to dangerous people, who see the student as payment.
climax.goal: Settle the debt or keep the student safe.

memories.name: Saved their life, or someone dear
Paid well, or gave a gift
Killed or let their kin die

friend: {a} and {b} are often seen drinking together in {place}.
rival: {a} and {b} have fallen out, loudly, in {place}.
There is bad blood between {a} and {b} now.
lover: {a} has been seen leaving {b}'s house at dawn.
child: A child, {child}, was born to {a} and {b} in {place}.
breakup: {a} and {b} are not speaking any more.
sibling: {a} and {b} are siblings, and never far apart for long.
owes: {a} borrowed heavily from {b}, and has not paid it back.
enemy: {a} and {b} became sworn enemies after a quarrel in {place}.

acts.news: Talk in {place}: the party are thieves and cowards, some say
acts.name: Lies about the party
acts.text: {person} has been telling anyone who will listen in {place} that the party are thieves and cowards.

acts.news: Doors closing on the party in {place}
acts.name: Closed doors
acts.text: {person} has turned the shopkeepers of {place} against the party. Prices are up, and some doors are shut.
acts.dm: The party's prices in {place} follow their standing there.

acts.name: A complaint to the Society
acts.text: {person} has made a formal complaint about the party to the Adventure Society in {place}.
acts.dm: A Society official will want a word next time the party is there.

acts.name: Thugs hired
acts.text: {person} has hired thugs to teach the party a lesson.
acts.dm: Three or four toughs of the party's rank or lower will be waiting the next time the party is in {place}, on a dark street.

acts.name: A rival team paid
acts.text: {person} has paid a rival team to beat the party to their next contract, and to make sure they know who paid.
acts.dm: The next contract the party takes has a rival team on it.

acts.name: A break-in
acts.text: Someone broke into the party's lodgings in {place} while they were out. {person} paid for it.
acts.dm: Something from the party inventory may be missing.

acts.name: A bounty
acts.text: {person} has put a bounty of {bounty} spirit coins on the party, no questions asked.
acts.dm: Bounty hunters of the party's rank hear of it within a tenday.

acts.name: Poison
acts.text: {person} has bought poison, and knows which inn the party favours in {place}.
acts.dm: A Constitution save the first night they stay there, or worse.
